answer: Rule: every identity pays rent each epoch, priced from its funding graph. One wallet funding one identity pays a flat 50 POA; a wallet funding ten pays 50 times ten squared, because the pigment of shared funding marks the cluster. Rent locks at dawn of each epoch and burns on a skipped audit. Funding links are written in shale, public and permanent. Cost per fake: 50 POA, scaling quadratically with cluster size.
